lines.zh: 我踩着翠绿山峰的陡坡
lines.en: I walk the steep slope of the verdant peak.
My talons hook into rock crevices.
I climb toward the ridge, step by step.
Wings folded, I walk steadier.

lines.zh: 风吹得我的羽毛往后倒
lines.en: The wind lays my feathers back.
I traverse across the mountainside.
Gravel slides away underfoot.
I look down and feel no fear.
My tail sweeps behind me.
I nudge a loose stone with my beak.
The summit clouds are beside me.

lines.zh: 我在山脊线上停了一停
lines.en: I pause on the ridgeline.
My talons grip hard when they land.
I walk downslope slowly.
The green valley lies below me.

lines.zh: 我走过一块突出的岩台
lines.en: I cross a jutting ledge.

lines.zh: 我立在山脊上，翅膀收着
lines.en: I stand on the ridge, wings folded.
Wind moves through the green valley.
I listen to sounds from below.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛在阳光下很亮
lines.en: My feathers shine in the sun.
Something rattles in the rock crack.
The rock under my talons is warm.

lines.zh: 这一带没有别的东西上来
lines.en: Nothing else comes up this high.

lines.zh: 崖边的风，把我的羽毛吹开。
lines.en: The cliff wind parts my feathers.
The peak is quiet but for wind.
I stare at the distant cloudline.
I draw myself up a little.
This height is what I'm used to.
My beak is hard and points forward.
I'll move when the wind suits.

lines.zh: 我偏头，看见你爬上来了
lines.en: I turn my head: you've climbed up.
Your footprints don't belong here.
I open one wing slowly.
On this ridge you have no retreat.

lines.zh: 你的高度让我不太满意
lines.en: Your height doesn't impress me.
I look you over from above.
My eyes are sharp.
The hand on the rock is shaking.

lines.zh: 我一动，碎石就会落下去
lines.en: If I move, gravel falls.
Do you mean to climb higher?

lines.zh: 我踉跄了一下，抓住岩石
lines.en: I stumble and catch the rock.
Several feathers come loose.

lines.zh: 我的重心偏了，翅膀张开
lines.en: My balance goes and my wings open.
That drove me back to the cliff edge.
I hiss, high and sharp.
Gravel falls away under me.
The blow bends my head down.

lines.zh: 翅膀有点歪，但不影响跳
lines.en: A wing's crooked, but I can still spring.
You fight better than I judged.
Mountain wind. Once more.
There's nothing like that up here.
You hold it up, half in the air.
I don't feed on the summit.
Set it down safely first.
Your open palm smells of meat.

lines.zh: 这味道被风一吹就没了
lines.en: The wind carries that smell away.

lines.zh: 你手一松，它就掉下去了
lines.en: Loosen your grip and it falls.
I tilt my head. I won't come near.
Doing that on a cliff edge is foolish.
Put it away and hold on.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，脚下碎石滚了
lines.en: You hit me and gravel scatters.
I don't give a step; my talons hold.

lines.zh: 你抓住我的羽毛才没滑
lines.en: You grab my feathers to keep from sliding.

lines.zh: 这一撞让岩台裂了条缝
lines.en: That knock cracks the ledge.
I turn aside and let you pass.
My feathers graze and your face reddens.
You back two steps against the rock.
Don't pull my tail feathers.
We collide again, a dull thud.
Stand sure. This slope is slick.
This peak is enough for two.
I have a nest past the ridge.
You needn't fly; I can't carry you.
Stand on my leeward side.

lines.zh: 这里的风从早上就这样
lines.en: The wind's been like this since morning.
I'll watch the high ground. You take the low.
I don't call out much. Don't mind it.

lines.zh: 等风转向，我们一起下去
lines.en: When the wind turns, we go down together.
My feathers are mussed. Help me straighten them.
This green mountain is worth a slow look.
I hook it with a talon.

lines.zh: 崖边的碎石里藏着东西
lines.en: Things hide in the ledge gravel.

lines.zh: 我叼起来，向上抛了一下
lines.en: I take it up and toss it once.
This can line the nest floor.
You dropped it; it rolled to the edge.
I nudge it back with my beak.
Too heavy. I won't carry it.
It's in a crevice; I dig it out.
Useful things go to the nest.
It's mine. Don't reach.

lines.zh: 我从峰顶滑下来，抓稳了。
lines.en: I glide down from the peak; hold tight.
You've climbed onto my ledge.
This lunge comes from above.
My talons arrive first.
You can't stand steady on the slope.
The mountain wind will hold you down.
Your shoulder is where I'll land.
Don't look up; the wind gets in your eyes.

lines.zh: 这一座峰，只有一个主人
lines.en: This peak has only one owner.

lines.zh: 翠绿山峰的风，把我的羽吹开。
lines.en: Peak wind spreads my feathers.
I'm not rushed, and you have no way out.

lines.zh: 翠绿山峰上，我的叫声最尖。
lines.en: On the verdant peak, my cry is sharpest.
I sidestep along the rock wall.
You're below the slope. I'm above.

lines.zh: 翠绿山峰上，我盯着你的落点。
lines.en: On the green peak, I watch where you'll land.
Gravel keeps sliding down.
You switched hands on the rock.
That instant is the opening.
I tuck my wings as tight as they go.
The wind is at your back.
My talons are one arm's length away.

lines.zh: 你听见爪子在石上刮吗
lines.en: Hear my talons scrape the stone?
I know this mountain better than you.
This is the last stretch.
Here. We do it here.
My talons rake your shoulder.
I dive down from above, heavy.
You're pinned against the rock.
This peck goes for your wrist.
We kick gravel off the cliff.
My wings beat up a gust.
You step back and your foot slips.
I tear open your pauldron.

lines.zh: 这一下带走了几根羽毛
lines.en: That cost me a few feathers.
I land and spring again at once.
Only the two of us on the ridge.
You won't last long.
I drop out of the cloud onto the ridge.

lines.zh: 翠绿的山峰多了个影子
lines.en: A new shadow on the verdant peak.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在石上抓出痕
lines.en: My talons score the stone.
Only one of me comes here at a time.
The wind flattens my feathers.

lines.zh: 我站在这块岩台上，很高
lines.en: I stand on this high ledge.
The valley is far below me.
I shake the mist off my wings.
The mountain air is clean.
I turn my head slowly, scanning.
No other nests in this area.
I wait here for the wind.
I hear movement below the peak.
I stamp the ledge. Solid.
My feathers catch and smoke rises.

lines.zh: 我从岩台滑下去，抓空了
lines.en: I slide off the ledge and miss my grip.

lines.zh: 水把我压住，翅膀挣不开
lines.en: Water presses me down; my wings can't work.

lines.zh: 气浪把我从石上掀下来
lines.en: The blast peels me off the rock.

lines.zh: 箭穿了我的翅膀，飞不了
lines.en: An arrow through my wing ends my flight.
That light won't disperse in the mountain wind.
Too starved for my talons to grip.
Lightning splits the summit rock.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，山谷也不见了
lines.en: The ground is gone, and the valley too.
